instruction: Run golangci-lint on every pull request.
output:
name: golangci-lint
on: pull_request
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'
      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: latest

instruction: Install ShellCheck and lint every shell script in the repository.
output:
name: shellcheck
on: pull_request
jobs:
  shellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
      - run: shellcheck scripts/*.sh

instruction: Lint the Dockerfile with Hadolint.

instruction: Initialize CodeQL, autobuild, and analyze JavaScript and TypeScript code.
output:
name: codeql-js
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript
      - uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

instruction: Scan the repository for secrets with Gitleaks on every pull request.

name: gitleaks
on: pull_request

instruction: Run the OpenSSF Scorecard security analysis and upload the results.
output:
name: scorecard
on:
  branch_protection_rule:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions: read-all
jobs:
  scorecard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ossf/scorecard-action@v2
        with:
          results_file: results.sarif
          results_format: sarif
          publish_results: true
      - uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: results.sarif

instruction: Enforce a minimum pytest coverage percentage as a quality gate.
output:
name: coverage-gate-tests
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install pytest pytest-cov
      - run: pytest --cov=src --cov-fail-under=85

instruction: Run cargo fmt and clippy on a Rust project.
output:
name: cargo-clippy
on: push
jobs:
  rust:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

instruction: Check Terraform formatting and run TFLint on the infrastructure directory.
output:
name: terraform-lint
on: pull_request
jobs:
  terraform:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: infra
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
      - name: Install TFLint
        run: |
          curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/terraform-linters/tflint/master/install_linux.sh | bash
      - run: tflint

instruction: Scan the repository history for secrets with Yelp detect-secrets.
output:
name: detect-secrets
on: pull_request
jobs:
  detect-secrets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install detect-secrets
      - run: detect-secrets scan --all-files > .secrets.baseline.new
      - run: diff -u .secrets.baseline .secrets.baseline.new

instruction: Run the unit tests and lint checks together as separate jobs joined by a required gate.
output:
name: lint-test-gate
on: pull_request
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make lint
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
  gate:
    needs: [lint, test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check results
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.lint.result }}" != "success" ] || [ "${{ needs.test.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
